subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel use the canonical stable OpenClaw runtime identity seam, or permanently support this new `serviceInstanceId` config and `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` override?
rationale: The assigned canonical issue leaves the stable identity source as a product/API decision, while the new override duplicates standard OTel resource configuration with different final precedence.

options.title: Use canonical runtime identity
options.body: Implement the bounded OpenClaw-controlled instance identity described by the canonical issue and avoid the new config and environment contract.

options.title: Sponsor operator override
options.body: Keep the new field only after defining precedence against `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES`, completing metadata, and proving the final export.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Defer the narrower implementation until the canonical issue settles the durable identity source.

recommendation.title: Use canonical runtime identity
recommendation.body: Implement the bounded OpenClaw-controlled instance identity described by the canonical issue and avoid the new config and environment contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and are assigned to the canonical issue defining this identity-source decision.
